thread:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty page fired -> SEV: P1 | region: eu-north | zone: az17 | symptom: sudden 5xx spike + shard evictions >50% over 2m. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/az-outage - pagerid: PD12345
PagerDuty: Alert routed to Kevin L (primary oncall)
Kevin L: acked. I’m taking this. oncall for next 30m.
Kevin L: quick check — are we seeing traffic reroutes already or is this before any automated fallback?
SRE-Oncall Bot: automated fallback policy "regional-failover-v2" NOT YET triggered. threshold not met for full failover; autopager configured to notify instead.
Maria V: logs show heavy kvcache evictions on eu-north-az17 nodes. sample: ```2026-03-15T10:02:11Z svc/inference ERROR kvcache_eviction key_cnt=120000 evictions=512 rate=85% host=eu-north-az17-node-09```
Anna (oncall): customer-facing errors reported for a subset of low-latency customers hitting /v1/chat and /v1/generate. error: 503 upstream_read_failed. product-ops pinged.
Kevin L: ok. immediate mitigation plan: 1) divert new traffic away from az17 2) spin up burst replicas in eu-north-az18 (if capacity) and us-west-az3 fallback 3) enable degraded-mode caching to reduce kv pressure.
Maria V: starting diversion now. infra command: `infra route divert --from eu-north-az17 --to eu-north-az18,us-west-az3 --policy gradual --pct=60`
Maria V: also scaling inference pool: ```kubectl scale deploy/inference-worker -n redwood-serving --replicas=40 --selector=zone=eu-north-az18```
SRE-Oncall Bot: divert job submitted at 3571592502. current divert pct=60 -> 40 to eu-north-az18, 20 to us-west-az3.
PagerDuty: Kevin L acknowledged at 3571592510; escalation timer paused.
Kevin L: good. Maria, can you flip the prefix cache to conservative? runbook section 3.2 shows command.
Maria V: done: `config apply prefix_cache.mode=conservative --env=eu-north-az17` // should reduce hot-key evictions.
Anna (oncall): checking customer impact dashboard — top affected customers: acme-corp (some requests failing), beta-saas (latency > 1.5s). Opening incident ticket for CS.
Product Ops: I’ve messaged CS with a heads-up and adding customers to the incident ticket. draft status-page: "Degraded API responses in eu-north due to zone instability; mitigations in progress." want me to publish?
Kevin L: wait 5m, confirm diversion and error rates. If errors drop <10% of baseline, publish with "investigating" status.
Maria V: eviction rate down to 32% after scale + cache change. 5xx rate reduced by ~45% in the diverted traffic buckets.
Kevin L: nice. start rebalancing more traffic away while we stabilize. set divert to 85%
Maria V: updated: `infra route divert --from eu-north-az17 --to eu-north-az18,us-west-az3 --policy gradual --pct=85`
SRE-Oncall Bot: fallback activation still not required; automated canary fallback idle.
Anna (oncall): monitoring logs for residual OOMs or requeue loops. will call for full failover if eviction rebounds.
Kevin L: escalation if not back to normal in 15m -> escalate to eng-platform and exec on-call.
PagerDuty: note: PD escalation chain will be invoked if ack removed/timeout.
Maria V: quick postmortem note — suspect network congestion between eu-north switches causing slow KV writes and subsequent cache pressure. collecting pcap + switch counters.
Kevin L: good. Maria, keep leading mitigation. Anna, coordinate CS comms and share affected customer list. Product Ops, hold the status update until I confirm SLOs trending back.
Anna (oncall): CS ticket created INC-20260315-az17. linking logs and customer IDs.
SRE-Oncall Bot: monitoring thresholds updated: eviction_rate_alert -> 40% (temporary) to avoid noisy alerts.
Kevin L: planning a 30-min handoff to Maria in 20m. I’ll remain reachable. anything else?
Product Ops: prepping post-incident banner & timeline template.
Maria V: capturing mitigation commands and timeline for postmortem. note: `kubectl get pods -n redwood-serving -l zone=eu-north-az17` shows several restart counts on proxy sidecars.
Kevin L: thanks all. leaving thread in watch state.
PagerDuty: Page remains acknowledged. will auto-close when alert clears or if Kevin clears.
Incident Bot: summary (to be added to ticket): P1 eu-north-az17 — transient kvcache evictions & 5xx spike; traffic diverted; scale/out-of-zone fallback used; customer impact limited to subset of low-latency tenants; follow-up: full postmortem and network vendor triage.
Anna (oncall): last check before handoff: error rate at 8% of baseline, divert stable, no new critical alerts. handing over to Maria for next 40m.
Maria V: taking over. will post final status when resolved or if we need full failover. :thumbsup:
